title: Online sale of medicines and medical products
summary: EU permits online sale of non-prescription medicines with an EU common logo; prescription-drug online sale rules set per member state. Other entries are mostly from general knowledge.

countries.name: European Union
countries.note: Falsified Medicines Directive 2011/62/EU: online sellers must be registered with national authority and show EU logo; Rx online sale per member state. EU is not an ISO country.

countries.name: Italy
countries.note: Online sale of prescription drugs prohibited (secondary summary read).

countries.name: United States
countries.note: State pharmacy licensure, DEA rules, Ryan Haight Act for controlled substances. from general knowledge, unverified.

countries.name: Canada
countries.note: Provincial pharmacy licences needed. from general knowledge, unverified.

countries.name: India
countries.note: E-pharmacy rules never finalised; Delhi High Court order led regulator to ask states to stop online sale (2018-19, secondary source).

countries.name: China
countries.note: Internet drug information service and online pharmacy licence required. from general knowledge, unverified.

countries.name: Japan
countries.note: Pharmaceutical and Medical Device Act: online sale of Rx drugs limited, OTC allowed with registration. from general knowledge, unverified.

countries.name: Australia
countries.note: TGA and state pharmacy licensing; Rx needs prescription. from general knowledge, unverified.

countries.name: Brazil
countries.note: ANVISA RDC 44/2009 allows online sale only by licensed pharmacies. from general knowledge, unverified.

countries.name: Russia
countries.note: Remote sale of Rx drugs allowed since 2021 only for licensed pharmacies on approved platforms. from general knowledge, unverified.

countries.name: Saudi Arabia
countries.note: SFDA licence required; online medicine sale only via licensed pharmacies. from general knowledge, unverified.

countries.name: United Arab Emirates
countries.note: MOHAP/DHA licensing for e-pharmacies. from general knowledge, unverified.
